map.转置和逆有什么关系？: How are transpose and inverse related?
map.两者是不同的运算，不要混淆。转置只是行列互换，任何矩阵都能做；逆要求方阵且行列式: They are different operations, do not confuse them. Transpose merely swaps rows and columns and works for any matrix; the inverse requires a square matrix with a nonzero determinant. Orthogonal matrices are the special case where the two coincide (A^-1 = A^T), common in rotation transforms and QR decomposition, but general matrices do not satisfy this relation.
